periods.analysis: In Q1, 160 residents attended nutrition and cooking sessions, mostly library demonstrations.
periods.recommendations: Add sessions at school family nights.

periods.analysis: Attendance rose from 160 to 245 with spring family nights at three schools.
periods.recommendations: Keep library demonstrations running through summer.

periods.analysis: Attendance reached 390 in Q3 with demonstrations at three library branches and two school family nights.
periods.recommendations: Offer pantry-staple recipes at food distributions to reach households that skip library events.
